objectiveHistory: Lock the replacement architecture for a centralized projection/display system that supersedes `mu_display`.

items.question: Where should the centralized projection system primarily live?
items.answer: Host-side projection registry with tool payloads as data input

items.question: Should the new system fully replace `mu_display` for all existing tools, or ship alongside it briefly during migration?
What should the single protocol optimize for first?
items.answer: Interactive UI first, transcript derived from it

items.question: How much control should the host renderer keep over final placement/styling?
items.answer: High host control; tools declare intent only

items.question: What is the most important property of the replacement?

notes: New recommendation: replace `mu_display` with one centralized projection/display protocol used by all tool outputs. That protocol should own transcript display, inline/dialog rendering, collapse rules, and optional interaction metadata so there is one source of truth instead of separate display/UI channels.
